name: ANAVASI
source:
A cinematic narrative game. Players take the role of Jason, a middle-aged game developer whose ordinary life is disrupted when he falls in love with a mysterious woman who belongs to a hidden society of vampires living in the shadows of modern-day Athens, Greece.

STEAM Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4173690/ANAVASI/
translation:
一款电影叙事游戏。玩家扮演杰森，一位中年游戏开发者，当他爱上一位神秘女子时，他的日常生活被打乱，这位神秘女子属于生活在现代希腊雅典阴影下的隐秘吸血鬼社团。

STEAM页面：https://store.steampowered.com/app/4173690/ANAVASI/
